faq: You do, from the Webflow marketplace, so the license sits in your account. Template prices run roughly from free to a few hundred dollars and are paid to Webflow or the designer. Our price covers customizing it.
Can you help me pick a template?
Yes. Tell us your business and the look you like, and we send two or three options with a short note on why each fits. You choose, then we start. Picking help is part of the order.
Can you change the template structure a lot?
Within reason. Colors, fonts, spacing, sections and layouts are fine. Rebuilding the whole structure is closer to a custom build, and we would then suggest our Webflow site build service instead.
Does the template include a blog or shop?
Many do. Blog and CMS layouts come ready, and we fill them with your first posts. Shop templates need a Webflow Ecommerce plan, and store setup is covered by our CMS and ecommerce service.
desc:
Webflow template setup and customization takes a polished marketplace template and makes it yours, with your brand, text and images. Ecom Swift LLC installs the template in your workspace and removes demo content, so the site looks like your business.

## What is Webflow template customization?

Webflow template customization is the process of taking a ready-made site design and adapting it to a specific business. A template provides the layout, sections and styles. We change the fonts, colors and spacing, replace placeholder content with yours and remove anything you do not need.

It is a practical middle path. You avoid the cost of a fully custom design, but you do not end up with a site that looks identical to the demo.

## Why a template needs more than swapped text

Templates arrive full of sample copy, stock photos and sections that suit a fictional company. Leaving them in place makes a site feel generic, and sometimes confusing. Visitors notice when an about page describes a business that is not yours.

Customization also protects quality. Templates are built to be flexible, which can mean extra styles and sections you will never use. Cleaning those up keeps the project lighter and the editing experience calmer.

## How a tailored template helps your business

A template that matches your brand looks credible and consistent. Your logo, colors and typography carry across every page, so visitors recognize you wherever they land. Clear content in the right places answers the questions buyers ask before they get in touch.

It also gets you online sooner. Layouts that already work for the structure of a typical business site save design time, and you spend your budget on content and the details that make you different. A working contact form and search titles complete the basics so the site is ready for real visitors.

## What a well-customized template includes

- The template installed in your own Webflow project.
- Your logo, brand colors and fonts applied across the site.
- Demo text and stock images removed or replaced.
- Pages filled with your content in the layout the template provides.
- Unneeded sections deleted and useful ones restyled or added.
- A contact form connected to your inbox.
- Template CMS collections filled with your items.
- Page titles and descriptions written so search engines can read each page.
- Buttons, cards and basic interactions adjusted to match your style.
- A responsive check on desktop, tablet and phone.

## How we handle it

If you have a template in mind, send us the link. If not, we suggest two that match your business and you choose. Once the template is in your workspace, we set the global styles first, then fill each page with your content and review it at each screen size.

The Basic package brands the template and fills a few pages, removing demo content. The Standard package fills more pages, restyles or adds a couple of sections, connects a contact form, fills template CMS items and adds search titles. The Premium package reshapes the template with extra sections, custom button and card styles, adjusted interactions, more CMS items and a walkthrough video, so it no longer looks like a template. An extra page, starter blog posts and a favicon and social image are available as add-ons.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Choose a template whose structure fits your content.
- Send your logo, colors and photos in good quality.
- Write short, clear text for each page.
- Check the template's included pages before you buy.
- Tell us which demo sections to keep and which to remove.

**Avoid:**
- Picking a template only because the demo photos look good.
- Leaving placeholder text or stock images on the live site.
- Expecting a simple template to become a very different layout in a basic package.
- Adding more fonts than the design needs.
- Skipping a check of the template's license terms.

## Who this service is for

This service suits new businesses that want a professional site without a custom design budget, freelancers and consultants who need a clear portfolio or services site quickly, and owners who already bought a template and are stuck at the demo stage.

## What we need from you

Tell us which template you prefer, or describe your business and style so we can suggest options. Please send your logo, brand colors, text and images. The template purchase is made by you, in your own Webflow account. We never need your password, and we work as a collaborator in your project.
